headlines.title: Ambassador Mike Waltz dismisses concerns over depleted U.S. weapons stockpile amid war with Iran
headlines.description: Mike Waltz, the U.S. ambassador to the United Nations, said in an interview on NBC’s “Meet the Press” that the U.S. has “everything that it needs” for military operations against Iran dismissing reports that the U.S. has depleted weapons stockpiles.

headlines.title: Democrats pick Troy Jackson to replace Graham Platner in must-win Maine Senate race
headlines.description: Former state Senate President Troy Jackson officially became Democrats’ Senate nominee in Maine Saturday, starting a 101-day sprint to Election Day in a nationally watched, must-win race for his party.

headlines.title: Amb. Mike Waltz: Signed U.S.-Saudi nuclear deal won’t be ‘implemented’ without Trump’s latest terms
headlines.description: U.S. Ambassador to the United Nations Mike Waltz tells Meet the Press that despite the U.S. signing a nuclear agreement with Saudi Arabia, President Trump will not implement the deal until the country normalizes relations with Israel and joins the Abraham Accords.

headlines.title: Kornacki: Which states Democrats ‘have to win’ for control of Congress
headlines.description: NBC News Chief Data Analyst Steve Kornacki joins Meet the Press to analyze the key issues weighing on Republicans and Democrats 100 days out from the midterm elections.

headlines.title: Trump Reportedly Puts Plans to Expand Iran War on Hold
headlines.description: Meet the Press moderator Kristen Welker joins NBC’s Joe Fryer on Sunday TODAY to discuss reports that President Donald Trump is putting plans to expand the war in Iran on hold as pressure mounts. “After weeks of saying Iran wanted to make a deal, he’s now saying Iran isn’t ready to make a deal so it’s just not clear where the offramp is here,” Kristen says.

headlines.title: Trump imposes 50% tariffs on dairy, alcohol, and cars from Canada
headlines.description: The Trump administration imposed 50% tariffs on three categories of imports from Canada, dairy, alcohol, and cars, citing discriminatory actions. NBC News' Monica Alba reports on how Trump is also considering additional tariffs due to the Canadian wildfires.

headlines.title: Map: How much you pay in federal and state gas taxes
headlines.description: As national gas price averages head toward $5 per gallon, one state has already suspended its gas tax, and now President Donald Trump and his Cabinet are talking about doing the same.

headlines.title: Trump orders signage warning visitors of ‘inaccurate information’ at Smithsonian
headlines.description: While he continues to seek control of the exhibits inside the Smithsonian Institution’s museums, President Donald Trump is trying a new tactic in the front yard.

headlines.title: Trump administration concedes that it canceled research grants in blue states
headlines.description: The Trump administration admitted that it terminated nearly 300 federal research grants “solely because” the projects were connected to states that voted against Trump in 2024

headlines.title: DNC committee sets up South Carolina to vote first in 2028 presidential primaries
headlines.description: South Carolina is poised to hold the first Democratic presidential nominating contest in 2028 after the Democratic National Committee’s powerful rules committee voted to keep the state at the front of the line.

headlines.title: Democrats reshape their primary calendar: From the Politics Desk
headlines.description: In today’s edition, Ben Kamisar breaks down Democrats’ new presidential primary order. Plus, Kristen Welker explores the political pressure the ongoing Iran war is putting on Republicans.
